Hi all —

Quick tax note: we can include VAT line items for the EU invoice, but we need the following from Novus to apply reverse-charge where applicable:
- EU legal entity name as registered (exact string)
- VAT ID for the entity (format validated against VIES where applicable)
- Billing country and whether the billing entity is VAT-registered in that country

If reverse-charge applies, the invoice will state "VAT reverse-charge — customer liable" and show the net amount with a VAT line of 0.00 but with the VAT ID recorded for audit purposes. If Novus requests Redwood to collect VAT on behalf of the EU entity, that will change our remittance routing and we will need 2-3 business days lead time to enable tax-collection mode in our billing system.

Also note: for accounting clarity please provide your desired cost-center tag (a short alpha-numeric code) per invoice line — we'll map that to GL buckets so your AP can auto-allocate.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Tax & Compliance
Redwood Inference
